Subdatasets of raster sources

Source: R/raster-info.R
vapour_sds.Rd

A data frame of the subdatasets of one or more raster sources, one row for each subdataset. This is the vectorised form of vapour_sds_names(), and it also gives GDAL's description of each subdataset.

Usage

vapour_sds(x)

Arguments

x

one or more data source strings, filename, database connection string, or other URL

Value

data frame with columns

dsn

the source, as given in x

sds

the number of the subdataset within its source, counted from 1 (as used by the sds argument of other functions)

subdataset

the data source string of the subdataset

description

GDAL's description of the subdataset, usually its dimensions, name and type

Details

A source with no subdatasets gives one row, in which subdataset is the source itself and description is NA. So every source has at least one row, and every value of subdataset is a data source that can be opened.

See also

vapour_sds_names() vapour_raster_info()

Examples

tif <- system.file("extdata", "sst.tif", package = "vapour")
vapour_sds(tif)
#>                                                      dsn sds
#> 1 /home/runner/work/_temp/Library/vapour/extdata/sst.tif   1
#>                                               subdataset description
#> 1 /home/runner/work/_temp/Library/vapour/extdata/sst.tif        <NA>

f <- system.file("extdata/gdal", "sds.nc", package = "vapour")
## protect from error with netcdf problems
result <- try(vapour_sds(c(f, tif)), silent = TRUE)
if (!inherits(result, "try-error")) {
  print(result)
}
#>                                                          dsn sds
#> 1 /home/runner/work/_temp/Library/vapour/extdata/gdal/sds.nc   1
#> 2 /home/runner/work/_temp/Library/vapour/extdata/gdal/sds.nc   2
#> 3     /home/runner/work/_temp/Library/vapour/extdata/sst.tif   1
#>                                                                subdataset
#> 1  NETCDF:"/home/runner/work/_temp/Library/vapour/extdata/gdal/sds.nc":vv
#> 2 NETCDF:"/home/runner/work/_temp/Library/vapour/extdata/gdal/sds.nc":vv2
#> 3                  /home/runner/work/_temp/Library/vapour/extdata/sst.tif
#>                           description
#> 1  [61x87] vv (64-bit floating-point)
#> 2 [61x87] vv2 (64-bit floating-point)
#> 3                                <NA>
